arguments.message: Hi there! The dashboard export is limited to 10,000 rows per download – it’s designed that way so the file can be generated in your browser without timing out. If you need to export more than that, set up a scheduled export to a cloud storage destination; those exports aren’t subject to the 10‑k row cap. You can also check the row count shown before you start the export against the total record count in Settings → Data → Overview to confirm how many rows are being omitted.
